# Repository metadata

## Description

Remove bot and fake followers from your X (Twitter) account. Free, open source. Detect bots, dry-run, bulk remove followers.

## Topics

twitter, x, x-twitter, bot-detection, fake-followers, remove-followers, bot-followers, twitter-bot, social-media, unfollow, chrome-extension, typescript, rust

## Applied repository settings

gh repo edit --add-topic twitter --add-topic x --add-topic x-twitter --add-topic bot-detection --add-topic fake-followers --add-topic remove-followers --add-topic bot-followers --add-topic twitter-bot --add-topic social-media --add-topic unfollow --add-topic chrome-extension --add-topic typescript --add-topic rust

The repository is named `altonwells/x-bot-follower-remover`, is public, and uses the MIT license. The requested description uses “dry-run”; the README clarifies that the current preview uses fictional accounts, not live follower data.
